children.text: Intercept {{version}} for Windows 11 x64 is on its way to your Downloads folder. Check the file, then install it in a few minutes.
Intercept needs Windows 11, version 24H2 or 25H2, on an x64 PC. On another device? Open this page on your PC to download.
Preview builds are unsigned, so the first run takes one extra click. Nothing is recorded until you start monitoring, and nothing leaves your PC.
Run Get-FileHash in PowerShell and compare the result with the SHA-256 above. A match proves the bytes, not who built them.
SmartScreen prevented an unrecognised app from starting.
SmartScreen may stop the first run. Choose More info, check the file name, then Run anyway. Builds stay unsigned during the preview.
It opens in Simple mode on Home. Nothing is recorded until you start monitoring, and there is no account to create.
Turn on input protection for sensitive apps and add Claude or Codex as trusted agents. Only optional features ask for administrator rights.
Preview {{preview}} is usable today, but the full V5 design is not finished. Check what is in this build before you rely on it.
Standard user. Administrator only for optional network and file tracing, the background service and the elevated input guard
None. Intercept makes no outbound connections
Manual. There is no update checker, so install new previews deliberately
Unsigned preview. Compare the SHA-256 before you run it
Stored locally in your Windows profile. Nothing is deleted automatically
